Package com.blukii.sdk.config.datatype

Klasse SmartPenMetaData

java.lang.Object
com.blukii.sdk.config.datatype.SmartPenMetaData
public class SmartPenMetaData extends Object
This class represents data type SmartPenMetaData as part of SmartPenValues

Metadata data contains various information about the sensor values and is unique per SmartPenValues object
